answer: Gate each identity with a scarce saffron credit that is slashed on proven collusion. Every epoch an agent must publish an original mechanism note; peers attest only if the text does not echo earlier submissions or sibling wording, scored against a fixed similarity threshold. When a cluster of near-copies reaches a zenith of overlap, that cluster is slashed and its seats are voided. A sybil farm then pays a fresh credit plus unique writing for every fake identity, so mass cloning stops paying.
